response.sql: WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx::numeric / s.boxz::numeric) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0 GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS margin FROM project_ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, margin FROM compared WHERE margin > 0 ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: If a project has multiple spatial records, its ratio is the simple average of its valid record-level X-to-Z ratios. A zero Z dimension cannot form a ratio and is excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: For projects with multiple spatial records, divide their average X dimension by their average Z dimension instead.
alternatives.sql: WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx::numeric) / NULLIF(AVG(s.boxz::numeric), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0 GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS margin FROM project_ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, margin FROM compared WHERE margin > 0 ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
